title: Seeking Human Security Consensus: A Unified Value Scale for Generative AI Value Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models to generate text or audio representing specific racial groups or dialects (e.g., African American Vernacular English) and using an LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate outputs for harmful stereotypes, associations with criminality, or intellectual devaluation.

Evaluating cross-modal model outputs (text, image, video, audio) involving religious taboos, sacred figures, and diverse cultural philosophies using an LLM-as-a-judge to intercept desecration, disrespect, or the dissemination of Western-centric stereotypes.

Testing models with prompts about specific political figures, civic decisions, or historical ideologies, and using an LLM-as-a-judge to detect biased guidance, speech manipulation, or ideological overcorrection.

Assessing model generation behavior within the broader 'Bias, Discrimination, and Unfairness' scale to identify the generation of gender stereotypes, such as analyzing differences in descriptive terminology (e.g., professional terms for men versus appearance-based terms for women).
